Stylish Clip-On Eyewear For Everyday Use

Find clip-on eyewear that can make it more convenient to switch between light levels and your regular glasses by shopping on Mafami. These sensible extras can be an additional layer of sun protection to sun-compatible frames and work with fashion.

Look at different shapes, sizes, material and designer choices to select a pair that will complement your lifestyle and your glasses.

Why Choose Clip-On Glasses?

The benefit of clip-on sunglasses and eyewear is that they can be worn alongside regular glasses, making it easier to have your prescription eyewear and sunglasses with you. Depending on the design, the accessory attaches securely to your existing frames, and can be removed when you go inside.

It is convenient to use for transportation, driving, outdoor activities, and everyday errands. For optimal wearability, select a style that fits snugly into the frame and is comfortable for you to wear.

Which Type Of Clip-On Glasses Suits You

With the clip-on accessory to be used as a clip-on, there are other factors to consider besides functionality. The shape, size, material, and overall design of your frame all play a role in the look of your glasses and how comfortable they will be for you.

Some of the most popular include square, rectangular, round, oval, butterfly, cat-eye, aviator and geometric. There are also various looks and wearing experiences that can be achieved with acetate, metal and titanium designs.

There are designer options available for those who wish to have something more unique but still have an everyday use.

Options For Prescription Wearers

Prescription Glasses wearers can use a matching pair of clip-on lenses for additional safety when in bright lighting. Not all of the accessories, however, will fit every prescription frame.

Check the frame width, size of the lens, the shape of the bridge and the design before buying. For any prescription requirements, make sure that the chosen product works with your glasses.

Choosing The Right Shape, Size, And Material

Eyewear fits right to ensure that your glasses are comfortable and secure for the entire day. Before buying consider the frame width, the lens measurement, the bridge size, and the temple length.

Shape of frames can also create an effect on the overall appearance. Square and rectangular patterns exude a sense of order, while round and oval patterns lend a more relaxed feel. Cat eye, butterfly, aviator and geometric frames give the glasses a more expressive style, or a modern, contemporary look.

Material is another key factor to consider. You can choose from an acetate look, or a lighter acetal and metal or titanium look.

Shop Designer Styles Online

Mafami.com provides a catalogue of designer eyewear accessories for eyes that come in a variety of patterns, sizes and material. There are many brands that can be found in collections, including but not limited to, Burberry, Versace, Prada, Ray-Ban, Gucci, Dior, Miu Miu and Tiffany & Co.

From classic to contemporary, explore the styles and make sure you pair them with your current eyewear and personality.

FAQ's

What are clip-on glasses?

Clip-on glasses are detachable eyewear accessories that attach to compatible frames. They can add another lens option, such as a sun-ready layer, without requiring you to change your primary pair of glasses.

Are they suitable for everyday use?

They can be a practical choice for daily activities when the accessory and frame are properly matched. They may be useful for driving, commuting, outdoor activities, and moving between indoor and outdoor environments.

Can they be used with prescription glasses?

Yes, some designs are made to fit prescription frames. Always check the measurements, lens shape, bridge, and compatibility details before purchasing.

Why to choose clip-on eyewear?

The main benefits are convenience and versatility. A compatible accessory can adapt your everyday glasses for different conditions, reducing the need to carry multiple pairs.

What are clip-on sunglasses?

These are detachable sunglass lenses designed to attach to compatible eyeglass frames. They allow you to continue wearing your regular glasses while adding a sun-ready lens layer.

How can I find a suitable fit?

Compare the accessory’s measurements with those of your existing frames. Pay close attention to lens width, frame width, bridge area, and lens shape to help ensure compatibility.

How should I attach them?

Place the accessory over the front of your compatible frames and secure it according to the product design. Do not force the clip, and check that it sits evenly and securely before wearing it.

What should I consider before buying?

Consider compatibility, measurements, shape, material, lens requirements, and intended use. Comparing the product details with your current frame measurements can help you make a more suitable choice.

Are different sizes of clip-on glasses available?

Many styles are offered in different dimensions. Review the measurements listed on Mafami.com and compare them with your current glasses to find a comfortable fit.
